campaign.name: C-ADD-CHECK strict improvement using code-calculus v0.2 admissible-added-checks

direction.hypothesis: Using code-calculus v0.2's admissible_added_checks and strict_improvement_feasible (cheap-first witness screening), valid C-ADD-CHECK moves with weight <= 6 on CSS parents with n <= 40 produce children with d' >= d+1, where v0.1 found 0/736.

bar.note: parents are small CSS entries; strict improvement means d child >= d parent + 1

direction.feasibility: admissible_added_checks enumerates valid supports up to weight 6; strict_improvement_feasible kills survivors that keep a minimum-weight logical; only survivors need a witness search.

novelty.claim: A CSS code one check addition away from a board entry with strictly larger distance

direction.expected_value: Any strict improvement would be the first on this board from C-ADD-CHECK and would reopen a move the v0.1 campaigns closed.

abandon_criterion.note: drop the addition route if no strict improvement survives the cheap-first screen across 2000 candidates

direction.what_a_negative_would_teach: That the v0.1 zero (0/736) was not a search-depth artifact: even with the v0.2 cheap-first feasibility check and admissible enumeration, no support kills every minimum-weight logical class at these sizes.

campaign.notes: Uses code-calculus-dev admissible_added_checks and strict_improvement_feasible. C-ADD-CHECK raises k? No: it lowers k by 1; strict improvement requires distance increase.
